events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: English actor, comedian, and screenwriter John Cleese, known for Monty Python and Fawlty Towers, celebrates his 87th birthday.

angles.name: Comedy Legend
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 87th birthday to the one and only John Cleese! From 'Monty Python' to 'Fawlty Towers', his comedic genius is truly timeless.

events.title: The Beatles' 'White Album' released
events.blurb: The Beatles' ninth studio album, officially titled 'The Beatles' but commonly known as 'The White Album', was released on November 22, 1968.

angles.name: Album Anniversary
angles.copy: 58 years since The Beatles unveiled their iconic 'White Album'! A double LP that broke all the rules and remains a masterpiece of diverse sounds. What's your favourite track?

events.title: Tribute to Freddie Mercury
events.blurb: November 24th marks 35 years since the passing of Queen frontman Freddie Mercury, who would have been 80 this year.

angles.name: Legendary Voice
angles.copy: Remembering the incomparable Freddie Mercury, 35 years on. His voice and stage presence remain unmatched, forever a legend of rock.

events.title: The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' released
events.blurb: The Beatles released their sixth studio album, 'Rubber Soul', on December 3, 1965, marking a significant artistic progression for the band.

angles.name: Album Anniversary
angles.copy: On this day in 1965, The Beatles dropped 'Rubber Soul'. An album that showcased their evolving sound and songwriting brilliance. Pure genius.

events.title: Tribute to John Lennon
events.blurb: December 8th marks the anniversary of the death of The Beatles co-founder John Lennon, who would have been 86.

angles.name: Peace & Music
angles.copy: Remembering John Lennon today, a visionary whose music and message of peace continue to resonate around the world. He would have been 86.

events.title: David Bowie turns 80
events.blurb: Legendary British musician and cultural icon David Bowie would have celebrated his 80th birthday today.

angles.name: Starman's Day
angles.copy: Celebrating the incredible legacy of David Bowie on what would have been his 80th birthday. Forever changing music and fashion.

events.title: Elvis Presley would have been 92
events.blurb: Today marks the birthday of the 'King of Rock and Roll', Elvis Presley, who would have been 92.

angles.name: King's Birthday
angles.copy: Happy birthday to the King, Elvis Presley! He would have been 92 today, still influencing generations with his iconic sound.

events.title: Jimmy Page turns 83
events.blurb: Led Zeppelin guitarist and rock legend Jimmy Page celebrates his 83rd birthday.

angles.name: Guitar God
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 83rd birthday to the legendary Jimmy Page! The guitar maestro behind some of rock's most iconic riffs.

events.title: Rod Stewart turns 82
events.blurb: British singer-songwriter Sir Rod Stewart, known for his distinctive raspy voice, celebrates his 82nd birthday.

angles.name: Rock & Roll Heart
angles.copy: Raise a glass to Sir Rod Stewart on his 82nd birthday! Still rocking stages and charming audiences with that unmistakable voice.

events.title: Suggs turns 66
events.blurb: Graham McPherson, better known as Suggs, the iconic frontman of Madness, celebrates his 66th birthday.

angles.name: Madness Maestro
angles.copy: Happy 66th birthday to the one and only Suggs! The charismatic frontman of Madness, still bringing the house down.

events.title: Paul Young turns 71
events.blurb: English singer Paul Young, known for hits like 'Wherever I Lay My Hat (That's My Home)', celebrates his 71st birthday.

angles.name: Velvet Voice
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 71st birthday to the soulful Paul Young! Still got that velvet voice.

events.title: Dolly Parton would have been 81
events.blurb: Today would have been the 81st birthday of country music legend Dolly Parton, who passed away on August 25, 2026.

angles.name: Country Queen
angles.copy: Remembering the incredible Dolly Parton on what would have been her 81st birthday. Her music and spirit continue to shine brightly.

events.title: Gary Barlow turns 56
events.blurb: Take That frontman and acclaimed songwriter Gary Barlow celebrates his 56th birthday.

angles.name: Take That Star
angles.copy: Happy 56th birthday to the brilliant Gary Barlow! From pop anthems to West End hits, a true talent.

events.title: Billy Ocean turns 77
events.blurb: Trinidadian-British singer-songwriter Billy Ocean, known for his string of 80s hits, celebrates his 77th birthday.

angles.name: Get Into The Groove
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 77th birthday to the legendary Billy Ocean! Get into the groove with his timeless hits today.

events.title: First Rock & Roll Hall of Fame induction
events.blurb: The very first Rock and Roll Hall of Fame induction ceremony was held on January 23, 1986, honouring rock's pioneering artists.

angles.name: Rock Royalty
angles.copy: On this day in 1986, the Rock and Roll Hall of Fame held its first-ever induction ceremony. A landmark moment for music history!

events.title: Mark Owen turns 55
events.blurb: Take That member Mark Owen celebrates his 55th birthday.

angles.name: Take That Star
angles.copy: Happy 55th birthday to Take That's Mark Owen! Still charming audiences after all these years.

events.title: The Beatles' Rooftop Concert anniversary
events.blurb: January 30, 1969, marks the date The Beatles performed their famous final public concert on the rooftop of Apple Corps headquarters in London.

angles.name: Iconic Performance
angles.copy: 58 years ago today, The Beatles made history with their iconic rooftop concert in London. The final public performance from the Fab Four!

events.title: Phil Collins turns 76
events.blurb: English musician, singer, songwriter, and record producer Phil Collins celebrates his 76th birthday.

angles.name: Drumming Legend
angles.copy: Happy 76th birthday to the incredible Phil Collins! A true legend of drums, vocals, and songwriting.

events.title: Hugh Grant turns 67
events.blurb: British actor Hugh Grant, known for his roles in romantic comedies, celebrates his 67th birthday.

angles.name: Rom-Com King
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 67th birthday to the charming Hugh Grant! Forever the king of British romantic comedy.

events.title: Justin Timberlake turns 46
events.blurb: American singer, songwriter, and actor Justin Timberlake celebrates his 46th birthday.

angles.name: Pop Icon
angles.copy: Happy 46th birthday to the multi-talented Justin Timberlake! From boyband to solo superstar, he's still bringing the hits.
